description:
[ECHA SCIP database dossier completeness screener. Deterministic validation, read-only, side-effect free]. Screens article SCIP notification dossiers under Directive 2008/98/EC Article 9(1)(i), verifying CN/TARIC codes, Candidate List SVHC ranges, material categories, and safe use instructions for IUCLID 6 submission.
Usage: Submit planned SCIP notification payload to verify mandatory data fields before submitting to ECHA Submission Portal.
Returns: JSON object with { articleName: string, isScipNotificationMandatory: boolean, dossierReadinessStatus: string, validationChecklist: object, missingMandatoryFields: array }.

articleName.description: Commercial or technical name of the article

primaryArticleCategoryCnTaricCode.description: 4 to 10 digit Combined Nomenclature / TARIC customs code

productionInEu.description: Whether the article was manufactured in the EU or imported

safeUseInstructionsProvided.description: Whether proper safe use instructions are included

safeUseInstructionsSummary.description: Summary of safe use instructions for waste operators

name: scip_notification_dossier_screener
